title: Expansion admission protocol
description: Objective: implement bounded expansion request, quality assessment, all-or-none refusal, exact budget preparation, and graph-level approval. Deliverable: core/scheduler expansion modules and race tests. NOT in scope: automatic approval or partial child activation. Hard dependencies: Anti-blocking admission, Fair scheduler production, Policy approval core, and Conserved budget core. Owned paths: packages/core/src/expansion/** and packages/scheduler/src/expansion/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core test && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Expansion is refused unless all quality, scope, budget, capacity, and dependency preconditions pass.
Approval binds exact proposed revision and prepared resources; a changed delta requires reapproval.
No child obtains authority from a partially admitted expansion.
Focused core and scheduler tests pass.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.

implementationPlan.description:
DoD 0 — the all-or-none precondition gate, in the pure expansion modules.
Expansion is REFUSED unless ALL FIVE precondition families pass: quality, scope, budget, capacity and dependency.
ASSERT EACH INDEPENDENTLY. A five-way conjunction is exactly where an unevaluated precondition hides: a combined check passes while one family is silently never consulted, and no single test notices. Drive one failing family at a time with the other four passing, and assert the refusal names WHICH family failed — a generic "refused" cannot distinguish a budget failure from a capacity one, and they need different repairs.
RAIL 1 BINDS HERE: a dependency, readiness, fairness or semantic claim WITHOUT DAEMON-VERIFIABLE EVIDENCE is UNKNOWN or REFUSED. A pure computation that concludes a precondition holds is not the same as evidence that it holds — where the fact is daemon-owned, the pure surface must return UNKNOWN rather than deciding.
Owned paths only: packages/core/src/expansion/** and packages/scheduler/src/expansion/**. Keep each module focused, <=250 lines, split before 400 (rail 3).

implementationPlan.description:
DoD 1 — approval binds the EXACT proposed revision and prepared resources, and a changed delta requires REAPPROVAL.
Bind both halves exactly: the proposed revision AND the prepared resources. An approval that binds only the revision would survive a change in prepared resources, which is the same authority applied to different work.
THE REAPPROVAL ARM IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS AND THE ONE MOST LIKELY TO PASS VACUOUSLY: assert that a CHANGED DELTA FORCES reapproval rather than silently reusing the prior binding. Silent reuse is the failure that looks like success — the flow completes, the approval record parses, and nothing is obviously wrong except that authority granted for one delta was spent on another. Drive a change in the revision and a change in prepared resources SEPARATELY; a combined case can pass on one binding while the other is unchecked.
NOT IN SCOPE (the row's own description): automatic approval, and partial child activation. Approval here is graph-level and manual.

implementationPlan.description:
DoD 2 — the clause QA failed this row on: NO CHILD OBTAINS AUTHORITY FROM A PARTIALLY ADMITTED EXPANSION.
THE PROOF MUST RUN THROUGH THE REAL CONSUMER EDGE. QA's rejection is precise about why the previous attempt failed: "This suite proves only exported pure surfaces." A pure test can show the reducer refuses a partial admission; it CANNOT show that no child obtains authority through an edge, because there is no edge in the test. That is the pure-package-with-no-consumer-edge defect, and it is a named epic rail — "exports the symbols" is not composition.
So the arm drives task-c4171c1c's DAEMON CALL SITE and proves that a PARTIALLY ADMITTED expansion yields NO child authority through it. c4171c1c's own DoD 2 requires a late refusal to leave no durable resource, CHILD, RUN, LEASE, effect, graph mutation or activation authority — the child/run/lease three ARE this row's clause, so the two rows' proofs meet at that edge by design.
Assert the ABSENCE of child authority explicitly, per category, not merely that the admission refused. A refusal that nonetheless left a child run or lease behind is exactly the defect — and "it refused" is not the same as "it left nothing behind".
RECORD task-c4171c1c AS THE CONSUMER, replacing the ARCHIVED task-9634ed3b. Verify its status at the time of writing — recording an archived consumer is how this row failed the first time.

implementationPlan.description:
DoD 3 and the race coverage the description names — focused core and scheduler tests.
The deliverable includes RACE TESTS, so cover the interleavings that matter for an all-or-none protocol: two concurrent expansion requests against one hold; a request racing an approval; an approval racing a delta change. Each must produce ONE winner or an exact refusal, never two admitted expansions, and the loser must leave nothing behind.
Every generated matrix asserts EXACT NONZERO CARDINALITY — a zero-case matrix passes while proving nothing.
Mutation drills, each run ALONE (a first red masks a second):
  (a) Skip one precondition family in the all-or-none gate — that family's arm must red. Run per family; this is what catches the silently-unevaluated conjunct.
  (b) Reuse a prior approval after a changed delta — the DoD-1 reapproval arm must red. Run separately for a changed revision and for changed prepared resources.
  (c) Let a partially admitted expansion yield a child — the DoD-2 arm must red. If it stays green the arm is not exercising the real edge, which is precisely the rejection this row is recovering from.
Back up any untracked path by SHA256 outside the tree, restore proved in a SEPARATE call.

   - same commandId twice: first DECIDED, second REPLAYED, SAME approvalIdentity and SAME recordAggregateId, exactly 1 recorded binding and 1 approval aggregate. One winner, no second grant.
   - INDEPENDENT commandId against the same hold: refused with the exact pair EXPANSION_ADMISSION_RECORD_CONFLICT / RECORD, upstream component DURABLE_STORE, and still exactly 1 record. This arm caught my own wrong prediction on the way in — I wrote layer "DURABLE" and it redded with "RECORD"; the pinned value is the measured one.
   The consumer's byte-set matrix runs each case in its OWN fresh world, so a two-request SEQUENCE against a single hold is uncovered there. This is additive, not duplicated.

planningNotes.risks:
1. THE CONSUMER ID IS LOAD-BEARING, NOT BOOKKEEPING. This row failed QA because the recorded consumer was ARCHIVED. Record task-c4171c1c and verify its status at completion time — an archived or deleted consumer is the same defect again.

2. DoD 2 CANNOT BE PROVEN INSIDE THE PURE PACKAGES. "No child obtains authority from a partially admitted expansion" is a statement about an EDGE. The proof runs through c4171c1c's daemon call site, whose own DoD 2 requires a late refusal to leave no durable resource, child, run, lease, effect, graph mutation or activation authority — seven categories, and the child/run/lease three are exactly this row's clause.

3. ALL-OR-NONE IS THE SUBSTANCE OF DoD 0: refusal unless ALL of quality, scope, budget, capacity and dependency preconditions pass. Assert each precondition INDEPENDENTLY — a combined check can pass while one precondition is silently unevaluated, and a five-way conjunction is where that hides best.

4. REAPPROVAL ON A CHANGED DELTA (DoD 1): approval binds the EXACT proposed revision and prepared resources. Assert that a changed delta FORCES reapproval rather than silently reusing the prior binding — reuse is the failure that looks like success, because the flow still completes.

5. RAIL 1: a dependency, readiness, fairness or semantic claim WITHOUT DAEMON-VERIFIABLE EVIDENCE is UNKNOWN or refused. Do not let a pure computation stand in for verified evidence.

6. RUN THE TWO VERIFICATION LEGS SEPARATELY. The row's verification string uses `&&`, which reports only the last command's exit code — a red @moe/core leg would be hidden by a green @moe/scheduler one. Read the count lines from each.

7. RAIL 3's caps: <=250 lines per production module, split before 400; explicit paths only; no sibling worktree.
